task: full-MSA replication of the candidate screen

text: PRE-REGISTERED (plan 048c532eb430). Study #9 re-run with a full MSA, same candidates, same RNG seed, 10 decoys each instead of 3. H1 FALSIFIED: mean paired (native - own decoy mean) = 0.0186, paired t p = 0.76814, Cohen's dz = 0.1271. H2 FALSIFIED: 0 candidates in the confident band. H3 CONFIRMED: mean native ipTM rose 0.2194 over the single-sequence run.

THE RESULT SEPARATES TWO THINGS THAT LOOKED THE SAME. The MSA genuinely and substantially raises ipTM — +0.2194 on average, and up to +0.42 on the AChE candidates — so study #9's registered confound was REAL and running #10 was necessary. But the rise applies to natives and decoys alike: mean native 0.6244 against mean decoy 0.6058, a gap of 0.0186 that is indistinguishable from zero. The MSA raises the LEVEL without creating SPECIFICITY, which is exactly the confound I registered in advance: it helps the receptor, which has thousands of homologues, not the peptide, which has none.

THE PILOT WAS MISLEADING, and this is why n=1 is not evidence. A single native-decoy pair measured before this study showed native 0.7588 against decoy 0.2986, a +0.46 separation that looked decisive. With 10 decoys the same candidate's decoy mean is 0.5935 and the separation collapses to +0.165, empirical p = 0.091. The single decoy happened to be the weakest of ten. Increasing decoys from 3 to 10 also flipped the running mean's sign twice during the run.

RANDOM SEQUENCES REACH THE CONFIDENT BAND. Decoy maxima with MSA: 0.9345 (MicroTrem2-Agonist-M1), 0.8561 (PfcACh-PAM-P1), 0.8261 (BasalSuper-AChE-TrkA-B5), 0.7784 (BasalAChE-Abeta-B4). Meanwhile NO native reached 0.8. So a composition-matched shuffle of a candidate's own amino acids scores in the band AlphaFold3 documents as confident, while the designed sequence does not. Reported without a null, any of those four would have read as a hit.

TWO STATED LIMITS. (1) The 2 of 6 candidates that beat all their decoys are HippoAChE-AlkaPept-X2 and BasalAChE-GorgeBlock-B1 — the duplicate sequence pair the data gate flagged. They are the same molecule, so they are NOT independent and the effective number of independent candidates beating their null is 1, at empirical p = 0.091 which cannot reach 0.05 with 10 decoys. (2) One fold of 66 failed, so n_observed = 65; the protocol audit flags the deviation.

SLATE COMPLETE. All 11 items of the expert panel's consensus slate have now been executed, including #10, which the panel classified needs-gpu at 100-250 GPU-hours. It ran here in about 5 hours of Apple MPS at a reduced but adequately powered scope (6 candidates x 11 folds), which the 128 GB unified memory made possible by removing the VRAM ceiling.
